page.layout: Running head at top, centred; below it a chapter title line with the page number at the right; then one column of numbered questions with page references at the right, ending with the last line of item 13.; One line of text at the top, centred; the rest of the page is blank.

main_text.head: De Priuatione, Cap. VI.
main_text.l: 1 An vocabulum privationis semper uno & eodem modo vsurpetur? 571
6 An a privatione ad habitum detur regressus? ibid.
7 An omnis privatio sit praeter naturam, & adiunctum contingens? 578
8 An privatio totaliter destruat subiectum sui habitus? ibid.
9 An detur medium inter privationem & habitum? ibid.
10 An privatio habeat causam sui sufficientem, & quae illa fit? 579
11 An privatio alia sit substantialis, alia accidentalis? ibid.
12 An privatio sit cuiusque accidentis & adiuncti? 180
13 An privatio differat a negatione pura & absoluta, & quomodo? ibid.

page.notes: Item 12 shows the page reference "180", which is probably a printing error for 580; left as printed. Item 1 "priuationis" and similar words are printed with u for v and are given with v as consonant. Only the printed page is transcribed; the handwritten number at the upper right is not included.
